name: comp1-network-plexus
description: Composition 1 – Network Plexus fly-through (4K, Remotion + Three.js)

scripts.downscale:v1: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/NetworkPlexus-V1-4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 16 -x264-params aq-mode=3 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -movflags +faststart -an out/NetworkPlexus-V1-1080p.mp4
scripts.downscale:v2: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/NetworkPlexus-V2-4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 16 -x264-params aq-mode=3 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -movflags +faststart -an out/NetworkPlexus-V2-1080p.mp4
scripts.deliver:v1: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run downscale:v1
scripts.deliver:v2: npm run render:v2:4k && npm run downscale:v2
scripts.deliver: npm run deliver:v1 && npm run deliver:v2
